title: Kissed Tender Spanish Turnip Empanadas
description: A traditional Galician dish featuring tender turnips and flaky yeast dough, perfect for a crowd, these empanadas are a bitter and savory delight. They are made with kosher-friendly ingredients and a touch of beurre-monte for added richness.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the olive oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
In a separate bowl, combine the diced turnips and beurre-monte.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and cut into circles.
Place a spoonful of the turnip mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
